updates.text: We have identified a problem with a third-party core processing system. Our branches are open and can help with deposits and withdrawals. Card purchases may be declined intermittently. We will post the next update by 10:30 AM.
We are continuing to investigate. Some ATMs in the Milford and Riverbend areas are out of service. We will never ask for your password or one-time code by phone, text or email.
We are investigating reports that members cannot log in to online or mobile banking.
